data.one_liner: A Flutter package to show simple music visualizer animation
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple music visualizer widget for Flutter applications. Supports play and pause states with animations that reverse when paused, as well as customization for color, width, height, and radius.
use_when: You want to display a simple music visualizer animation in your app
You need to indicate audio playback states with animated visualizer bars
avoid_when: You need complex spectrum analyzers or real-time audio frequency data processing
You are not building an audio-related feature
strengths: Easy to integrate with a straightforward widget API
Supports play and pause animation states
Cross-platform support across mobile, web, and desktop
weaknesses: Limited to simple visualizer animations rather than real audio-reactive analysis
Not documented for advanced customization beyond basic styling properties
